families: 22 original dev + 18 paired condition variants; not independent tests
transform: nonempty stripped lines; first line Markdown H1; remaining lines blank-separated

metrics.source_hit: any returned source filename in a necessary-evidence group
metrics.necessary_clause_coverage: fraction of evidence groups with at least one complete normalized original clause present in combined returned text
metrics.anchor_clause_coverage: same metric using anchor chunks before adjacent expansion
metrics.unsupported_retrieval: any match for an unanswerable query
metrics.latency: warm sequential local retriever wall time including SQL and context validation; excludes model startup

limitations: No answer generation, semantic correctness or independent blind review claim. Families correlated; scope filtering not part of this factorial comparison.
